name: Spawn Researcher on New Task
description: When dispatch submits a task with role=general, spawn a researcher to investigate. The researcher gathers evidence using graph queries and web search, then submits findings.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.$entity.task_id.research
on_enter.prompt:
Research the following question thoroughly. Use graph_query to check existing knowledge, web_search for external sources, and http_request to fetch specific URLs.

Question: $entity.result

If the question has clearly separable subtopics, include a SUBTOPICS section at the end of your findings listing each subtopic on its own line prefixed with '- '. Otherwise, provide your complete findings.

Submit your work when research is complete.
